'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[2022 bombing of Odesa]]
****Infrastructure in the Southern Ukrainian city of [[Odesa]] is hit by [[airstrike]]s, killing at least five people, including a baby, and injuring 18 others, according to the local authorities. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/missile-strike-kills-five-people-ukraines-odesa-region-says-official-2022-04-23/ (Reuters)] [https://www.timesofisrael.com/ukraine-says-russian-strike-on-odesa-killed-5-including-three-year-old-infant/ (''Times of Israel'')]
***The [[Investigative Committee of Russia]] announces that they are investigating allegations by [[RIA Novosti]] that troops from the [[United Kingdom|British]] [[Special Air Service|SAS]] have been deployed to Western Ukraine. [https://www.reuters.com/world/russia-investigates-media-report-presence-british-sas-special-forces-ukraine-2022-04-23/ (Reuters)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/4/23/russia-investigates-report-of-british-sas-forces-in-ukraine (Al Jazeera)]
*[[War in Darfur]], [[Darfur genocide]]
**[[Human rights group]]s say that eight people were killed during clashes followed by a [[Janjaweed]] raid on Thursday and Friday in Kreinik, [[West Darfur]]. [https://apnews.com/article/middle-east-africa-sudan-violence-2ccc878ce06a9fb4993e52a4683e7d4a (AP)]
*[[2021–2022 Democratic Republic of the Congo attacks]], [[Ituri conflict]], [[Kivu conflict]]
**[[Kenya]] says that the [[East African Community]] plans to deploy a [[peacekeeping force]] in the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://apnews.com/article/africa-kenya-nairobi-uganda-east-99773d0497e1ee5a4d80e7443bc0c14a (AP)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**Unknown gunmen from [[Afghanistan]] storm a [[Pakistan Armed Forces|Pakistani military]] [[Outpost (military)|outpost]] near the [[Durand Line|border]] in [[Pakistan]]’s [[North Waziristan District]], killing three [[Pakistan Army|soldiers]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/4/23/pakistan-army-post-attacked-by-fighters-in (Al Jazeera)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Imo/Rivers explosion]]
**Over 100 people are killed after an illegal [[oil refining]] depot explodes in [[Ohaji/Egbema]], [[Imo State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/explosion-illegal-oil-refining-depot-nigeria-kills-over-100-2022-04-23/ (Reuters)]
*[[European migrant crisis]]
**At least 17 migrants are killed after four boats sink off the coast of [[Sfax]], [[Tunisia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/death-toll-migrant-shipwrecks-off-tunisia-rises-17-2022-04-24/ (Reuters)]
*Three people are killed and 98 more are rescued after an explosion at the Gaisky ore [[mining in Russia|mine]] in [[Orenburg]], Russia. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/three-miners-killed-explosion-russian-mine-agencies-2022-04-23/ (Reuters)] 
*Ten people are dead and 16 more are missing as a [[sightseeing]] boat sinks off [[Japan]]'s northern [[list of islands of Japan|island]] of [[Hokkaido]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/four-people-found-missing-japan-ship-condition-unknown-nhk-2022-04-24/ (Reuters)]
*Four people are dead and six more are missing after an accident in a [[coal mine]] in [[Jastrzębie-Zdrój]], [[Poland]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/least-one-miner-dead-six-trapped-after-tremor-polish-coal-mine-2022-04-24/ (Reuters)]
*One person dies and 40 people are rescued after a boat sinks in [[Tripoli, Lebanon|Tripoli]], [[Lebanon]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/boat-sinks-lebaneses-tripoli-port-with-60-board-tv-citing-red-crescent-2022-04-23/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Russia–Turkey relations]]
**[[Turkey]] closes its airspace to [[Russian Armed Forces]] flights to [[Syria]], as well as civilian aircraft that are suspected of carrying Russian troops. [https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/article-704910 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*Thousands of [[Argentinian]] [[farmer]]s protest against [[President of Argentina|President]] [[Alberto Fernández]]'s new export taxes on farm goods, which protesters say is a "rope that is being used to choke us". The farmers used [[tractor]]s to block the road leading to the [[Casa Rosada]] in [[Buenos Aires]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/thousands-farmers-stage-anti-tax-protest-argentine-capital-2022-04-23/ (Reuters)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2022 Major League Baseball season]]
**In [[baseball]], the [[Chicago Cubs]] defeat the [[Pittsburgh Pirates]], 21–0, the largest defeat in [[History of the Pittsburgh Pirates|Pirates history]] and the largest victory in [[History of the Chicago Cubs|Cubs history]] since 1901. [https://www.cbsnews.com/pittsburgh/news/pirates-surrender-21-runs-to-cubs-in-worst-loss-in-franchise-history/ (CBS News)] [https://chicago.suntimes.com/cubs/2022/4/23/23038891/cubs-make-history-in-21-0-rout-of-pirates-alfonso-rivas-seiya-suzuki (''Chicago Sun Times'')]
*[[Tyson Fury vs. Dillian Whyte]]
**[[Tyson Fury]] [[List of WBC world champions|retains]] the [[World Boxing Council|WBC]] world [[heavyweight]] title after defeating [[Dillian Whyte]] via [[technical knockout]] in round 6 in front of 94,000 spectators at [[Wembley Stadium]], [[London]], a [[post-war]] British record. Post-match, Fury suggests that he may now retire from [[professional boxing]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/boxing/61188235 (BBC Sport)]
